question: When x is added to each of 7, 13, 19 and 29 the numbers so obtatined in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (3x - 8) and (x + 5)?
solution:
**Given:**

x is added to each of 7, 13, 19 and 29

**Formula used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d

Also, b is the mean proportion of a and b then b = √ab

**Calculation:**

(x + 7)/(x + 13) = (x + 19)/(x + 29)

⇒ (x + 7) (x + 29) = (x + 13) (x + 19)

⇒ x2 + 7x + 29x + 203 = x² + 13x + 19x + 247

⇒ 7x + 29x - 13x - 19x = 247 - 203

⇒ 4x = 44

⇒ x = 44/4 = 11

The mean proportion = √[(3x - 8) (x + 5)]

= √[(3 × 11 - 8) (11 + 5)]

= √(25 × 16)

= 20

**∴ The mean proportional between (3x - 8) and (x + 5) is 20**
